machine: colima VM, 8 CPUs, 16 GB, arm64 LibreLane image; one layout at a time
large_files: GDS, DEF and run folders stay out of git, under chiplab/runs/ of the layout worktree

layouts.checks_note: lab config runs no Magic or KLayout DRC and no LVS (RUN_MAGIC_DRC, RUN_KLAYOUT_DRC, RUN_LVS false); route__drc_errors is the router's DRC count, antenna and slew/cap counts come from OpenROAD

estimate_at_latest_step.basis: metrics LibreLane recorded after the latest completed step (before detailed routing they use global-route parasitics, so they are estimates)
